title: Payment Arrangements Collector Guide — Statement Lead After Client Credits on the Placed Account
content:
Restarting plans under Payment Arrangements carry a statement lead set by the client credits booked to the placed account in the last three months.

## Rule

The statement lead follows the client credits booked to the placed account in the last three months:

- a charity care write-off or insurance payment credit adds 5 days, so the consumer has the corrected statement before the first restarted debit;
- any other client credit adds 2 days;
- no client credit adds 0 days.

The client credits are the client adjustment entries on the money history of the placed account the plan pays, under Placed Consumer Accounts, each carrying its adjustment reason; they are placed in the period by their booking date. Periods of three months are counted in whole months back from the handling date. Where both a charity care write-off or insurance payment credit and another client credit fall in the period, the 5 days apply.

## Grid

| Client credits booked to the placed account, last 3 months | Statement lead |
|---|---|
| At least one charity care write-off or insurance payment credit | 5 days |
| Client credits, none of them charity care write-off or insurance payment | 2 days |
| No client credit | 0 days |

## Hypothetical account histories

- An insurance payment credited by the hospital client six weeks ago: 5 days.
- A client credit booked two months ago for a reason other than charity care write-off or insurance payment, no other credit: 2 days.
- A charity care write-off booked four months ago and nothing since: outside the three months — 0 days.
